node.statement: Precisely, substituting B_{P_n,Q_n}=iota_n(B_{P,Q}) from 1.2 into the defining formula gives only Co_{P_n,Q_n}=theta(iota_n(B_{P,Q})). The desired right-hand side is iota_n(theta(B_{P,Q})); no algebraic manipulation of the defining formula identifies them. The missing equation is exactly the conditional conclusion of 1.3, whose extra functional-calculus hypothesis is absent. Thus the verifier objection identifies a genuine missing allowed premise rather than a bridgeable proof gap.
